sources.label: Science Advances, November 4, 2026 — Common transcriptional changes in the brain during hibernation and Alzheimer’s disease

research.summary: Colour gathers, recedes, and leaves something unresolved. Inspired by a study of hibernating hamsters whose brain cells share some transcriptional changes with Alzheimer’s disease, without the reported amyloid accumulation or neurodegeneration.

title: An Unsettled Season · 未定的季节
